angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 816,752 km at 160.16 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.2438 +/- 0.0146 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92): 160.16 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.174 +/- 0.026 solar radii from Nikolov et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014MNRAS.437...46N/abstract): 816,752 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.151 +/- 0.052 solar masses from Nikolov et al. 2014, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014MNRAS.437...46N/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5980 +/- 49 K from Nikolov et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014MNRAS.437...46N/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Nikolov et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014MNRAS.437...46N/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-1.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.360, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-1 (pscomppars): spectral type G0 V, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+37 4734B: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-1 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.13 dex, from Nikolov et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014MNRAS.437...46N/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-1 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.22463, from Barstow et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017ApJ...834...50B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-1 (pscomppars): age 3.6 Gyr, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-1 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.2 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
